title: 甜甜练习 (Tiantian Drill)
description: A math drill where every correct answer turns up the show: Tiantian the ragdoll cat carries your digits into the column, and confetti, music and parades build toward a full festival finale. Grades 1-6 arithmetic with skill trees, daily quests and trophies. Wrong answers never end the run.
controls: Type 0-9 and press Enter to answer, Backspace to erase, Esc to go back — or tap the on-screen number pad. Everything else is point-and-click.
